newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs coralled in 130.85/130.25 range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs coralled in 130.85/130.25 range.

text.p: September BTP futures traded on LIFFE were stripped of direction on Friday, after trading an inside day in the prior session, technical analysts said.
On Thursday, the contract traded in a 130.85 to 130.28 range, and closed mid-range. The range failed to extend either above or below Wednesday's 130.88 to 130.25 session.
"BTPs are stuck in the 130.25 to 130.85 range," said a broker at a European bank. "They need to break above the 131.00 level to open up the way to a test of the contract high at 131.86."
September BTPs were unchanged at 130.52 by 0824 GMT.
Further out, the prospects for BTPs brighten but the key 131.00 level must be broken with good volumes in order to gain upside potential, according to technical analysts at an Italian bank.
Analysts said the technical position also strengthened after BTPs broke above a downtrend drawn from the contract high in May.
On the downside, support for Friday was initially at congestion at 130.40/60, and below there at 130.25, the June 4 low.
"It's key for the contract to hold above the support around 130 the figure," said the broker.
A break through there would target 129.50 and 129.00 analysts said.
At the short end, September Eurolira futures were expected to be steady after recent declines have reversed the overbought reading. The contract was up one basis point at 93.39 by 0850 GMT.
